purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/janome-coverpro-2000cpx.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Page last modified 2025-06-30 per page metadata. Lists key features, standard accessories and a specification block.
Text PDF. Parts list, needles, stitch widths. No specification table, weight or spm figure found in it; no mention of TLC or STS.
Image PDF, read by OCR at 150 dpi; wording verify against the PDF. Linked from https://www.janome.com/support/warranty/. Applies to Janome America sewing machines generally, not model-specific.
CoverPro 3000 Professional, comparison only. janome.com/product/coverpro-3000cpx/ returns 404; the maker's name is 3000 Professional (3000P).

facts.value: Limited 25 Year Warranty: 25 years from original purchase against defects in materials or workmanship, excluding (i) electronic component parts, 5 years, and (ii) labor, 1 year free. Machines used commercially: 1 year parts and service. No cover for needles, needle plates, bobbin cases, fuses, light bulbs, knives, loopers or belts. Void if not bought from an authorized Janome dealer in the United States. Original purchaser only.
facts.spec_value: 25 yr parts, 2 yr electrical, 1 yr labor (Janome America)
facts.note: Maker wording says 5 years for electronic component parts, not 2. Spec source is a dealer page. The warranty document is general to Janome America machines, not specific to the 2000CPX; the product page does not state terms. Wording read by OCR, verify against the PDF.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 25 years parts and workmanship; 5 years electronic components; 1 year labor (Janome America general terms)

facts.value: Needle system ELx705. Manual: standard set of 2 x #80/12 and 3 x #90/14 (Schmetz EL X 705); machine is installed with #80/12 needles; use EL X 705 size 80/12 or 90/14
facts.note: Spec says 90/14 supplied; the manual says the machine ships with 80/12 installed plus a set of both sizes. The product page's standard-accessory list does not list needles. Manual is the 2019 upload and may predate current packing.

facts.value: Foot control, lint brush, needle threader, screwdriver large, screwdriver small, spool holder (large); features list adds 4 cones of thread, dust cover, LED light
facts.spec_value: Standard foot; needle set ELx705; electronic foot control; dust cover (standard accessories per dealer listing)
facts.note: Manual's list differs (needle set, screwdrivers, tweezers, nets, spool holder caps, lint brush, needle threader, attachment screws). Page vs manual accessory lists disagree; treat the contents as soft.

facts.value: Not mentioned on the 2000CPX page or in the manual; the 1000CPX page features STS
facts.spec_value: Differential feed; Seam Tightening System (STS); Tension Level Control (TLC); no knife
facts.note: Our spec feedSystem and claims credit the 2000CPX with STS and cite the 2000CPX product page. That page lists TLC and a tension release device, not STS. STS is a 1000CPX feature on the maker's pages. Editor should remove STS from the 2000CPX or re-source it.

facts.value: 'Tension Level Control (TLC)' on the 2000CPX page
facts.note: Trademarked tension feature; present on page, not in the 2019 manual.
